workflow_rationale: This is a straightforward cleanup task removing duplicate custom UI components in favor of existing @xala/ds components. The backoffice StatusBadge is already unused, and minside SeasonStatusBadge has only 2 usage locations. No complex refactoring or multi-service coordination required.
